_about: The November winter push as Postiz posts. Times are local to the zone named; schedule.py converts to UTC. Channels: instagram, facebook, linkedin (the LinkedIn page is used when connected, the profile otherwise). Images are the 1080-wide JPEGs in marketing/stories/out/jpg (Instagram takes JPEG only).
